domains.name: Medical Diagnostics
domains.label: medical diagnostics
domains.caution: Decision support only. This is not a medical diagnosis. Consult a qualified clinician.

domains.name: Cardiology & ECG Review
domains.label: cardiology and ECG review
domains.caution: Illustrative simulator only. Not clinically validated and not a diagnosis. Chest pain, fainting or a fast or irregular heartbeat can be emergencies: seek urgent medical care.

domains.name: Energy, Mining & Aviation Safety
domains.label: energy, mining and aviation safety incident analysis
domains.caution: Illustrative simulator only. Not a substitute for a qualified investigation or the applicable safety regulations.

domains.name: Education & Learning Support
domains.label: learning difficulty analysis
domains.caution: Decision support for educators. Not a diagnosis of any learning disability. Involve qualified specialists and the family.
domains.description: The most likely barrier behind a learner's struggles, from classroom and assessment signals, to help educators choose where to look first.

domains.name: AI & ML Systems
domains.label: AI and machine learning failure diagnosis
domains.description: Why a machine learning or LLM system is underperforming (leakage, drift, retrieval, overfitting and more), from training and production signals.

domains.name: Robots & Robotics
domains.label: robot fault diagnosis
domains.description: The likely cause of a robot fault or degraded performance, from joint, sensor, power and navigation signals.

domains.name: Process Industries
domains.label: process plant upset diagnosis
domains.caution: Decision support only. Follow the plant's operating procedures and involve a qualified process engineer for any safety-relevant action.
domains.description: The likely cause of a process plant upset (chemical, food, pharma, refining), from temperatures, pressures, flows and instrument signals.

domains.name: Manufacturing & Quality
domains.label: manufacturing defect root-cause analysis
domains.description: The root cause of a manufacturing defect or quality drift, from machine, material, operator and measurement signals.

domains.name: Spacecraft Operations
domains.label: spacecraft anomaly investigation
domains.caution: Illustrative simulator only. Not flight-qualified. Real anomaly response follows the mission's flight rules and engineering review.
domains.description: The likely cause of a spacecraft anomaly, from power, attitude, thermal, communications and fault-protection telemetry.

domains.name: Financial Markets
domains.label: financial market move analysis
domains.caution: Educational analysis of what may explain a market move. Not financial advice and not a trading signal.
domains.description: What may explain a market move (earnings, central bank, liquidity, squeeze, flows), from price, volume and event signals. Educational, not advice.

domains.name: Trading Systems
domains.label: trading system diagnostics
domains.caution: Operational diagnostics for trading systems. Not trading or investment advice.
domains.description: Why a trading system is misbehaving (data, latency, execution, risk, regime), from operational and performance signals. Not advice.

domains.name: Autonomous Vehicles
domains.label: autonomous vehicle fault diagnosis
domains.caution: Illustrative simulator only. Not a safety case, validation result or certification tool.
domains.description: The likely source of an autonomous vehicle fault or odd behaviour, from perception, localization, planning and actuation signals.

domains.name: Power Grid & Utilities
domains.label: power grid disturbance diagnosis
domains.caution: Illustrative simulator only. Grid operations follow the operator's procedures and protection engineering.
domains.description: The likely cause of a power grid disturbance, from frequency, voltage, protection and weather signals.

domains.name: Agriculture & Crop Health
domains.label: crop health diagnosis
domains.caution: Decision support only. Confirm with a local agronomist or a lab test before treating.
domains.description: The likely cause of crop stress, from symptoms in the leaves, roots, soil and recent weather.

domains.name: Hospital Operations
domains.label: hospital operations bottleneck analysis
domains.caution: Operational analytics only. Not clinical decision support.
domains.description: The operational bottleneck behind ED crowding and delays, from flow, staffing and capacity signals.

domains.name: Electric Vehicles
domains.label: electric vehicle fault diagnosis
domains.caution: Illustrative simulator only. Not a substitute for a certified EV technician. High-voltage systems are dangerous.
domains.description: The likely cause of an electric vehicle problem (range, charging, power, noises), from driver-visible and diagnostic signals.

domains.name: EV Battery Systems
domains.label: EV battery pack diagnosis
domains.caution: Illustrative simulator only. Battery faults can be a fire or electrical hazard; involve a qualified battery engineer.
domains.description: What is behind an EV battery pack issue (imbalance, cooling, aging, shorts), from cell, thermal and BMS signals.

domains.name: Oil Refinery
domains.label: refinery unit upset diagnosis
domains.caution: Illustrative simulator only. Refinery operations follow site procedures and process safety management; involve qualified engineers.
domains.description: The likely cause of a refinery unit upset, from furnace, column, catalyst, crude and product-quality signals.

domains.name: Gold Refinery
domains.label: gold refining process diagnosis
domains.caution: Illustrative simulator only. Assay results and refining decisions need qualified metallurgists and certified assays.
domains.description: The likely cause of a gold refining problem (fineness, recovery, losses), from leach, furnace, electrolysis and assay signals.

domains.name: Sensor Technology
domains.label: sensor and measurement fault diagnosis
domains.description: Why a sensor or measurement chain is misreading (drift, noise, wiring, calibration), from the reading behaviour.

domains.name: Renewable Energy
domains.label: renewable energy plant diagnosis
domains.caution: Illustrative simulator only. Site maintenance decisions need qualified engineers and OEM guidance.
domains.description: Why a solar, wind or storage site is under-producing, from output, inverter, turbine and grid signals.

domains.name: Commodities Trading
domains.label: commodity price move analysis
domains.caution: Educational analysis of what may explain a commodity move. Not financial advice and not a trading signal.
domains.description: What may explain a commodity price move (supply, inventories, weather, positioning), from market signals. Educational, not advice.

domains.name: Forex Exchange Trading
domains.label: currency market move analysis
domains.caution: Educational analysis of what may explain a currency move. Not financial advice and not a trading signal.
domains.description: What may explain a currency move (policy, data, risk flows, liquidity), from market signals. Educational, not advice.

domains.name: Accounting Systems
domains.label: accounting discrepancy diagnosis
domains.caution: Operational diagnostics only. Not accounting, tax or legal advice. Material discrepancies need a qualified accountant.
domains.description: The likely cause of a ledger or reconciliation discrepancy, from reconciliation, posting and integration signals.

domains.name: Auditing Systems
domains.label: audit finding root-cause analysis
domains.caution: Decision support for audit teams only. Not an audit opinion; professional judgement and evidence are required.
domains.description: The likely root cause of an audit finding, from control-testing and environment signals. Decision support, not an audit opinion.
